title: A Smile for the House
author: Wendell Brightwater
blurb: Astrid Oyelaran, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must return what was taken in 1974 before the last resident signs the papers.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
